basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI-Native Product Engineer | Design-Driven Full-Stack Builder | Founder, Speaker & Open Source
basics.summary: Full-stack builder who ships AI-native products end to end and treats craft, taste and polish as the thing, not the afterthought. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building production agentic systems on GCP that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. Run Anand Creations on the side, home to three founded products (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI), each taken from concept to real customers with AI as a core building tool. Public voice through 4 international conference talks, published writing (TowardsAI, Substack), and open source used in the wild (Robogen at EPFL on the AWS blog; Terraform module with 4,600+ users). 13+ years shipping to 10M+ users.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed live to the UI over AG-UI. Owned the visual and interaction design of the agent experience end to end, not just the backend. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub grounds RAG so the surface layer stays trustworthy.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, evals, tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call. Report directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Built a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Designed the authoring flow so non-technical customers go from zero to a live, on-brand experience in minutes.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; product team ships in new languages without a gatekeeper.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator that auto-composes personalized, on-brand streams from Salesforce data. Improved demo speed, close rates, and time-to-first-value.

Architected Employee Referral System end to end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed the customer-facing UX for 99.99% SLA because trust is measured in uptime and polish.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Shipped the end-to-end delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL) with the operator UI I designed myself. 500+ successful autonomous last-mile deliveries in the real world.
Put prototypes in front of real customers and turned each into a narrative that closed the next opportunity. Enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.position: AI Research Engineer & Open Source Maintainer
highlights: Built and open-sourced Robogen, a platform used by researchers and students to design, evolve, and 3D-print real robots. Public work, publicly maintained; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students hands-on through evolutionary AI and embodied learning.

projects.name: Anand Creations - AI Products & Forward Deployed Engineering
projects.description: Independent studio and home for the AI-native products I design, build, and ship on my own (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI). Site, brand, and every product surface designed by me. Concept to customer, with AI as a core building tool at every step and craft treated as the deliverable, not the wrapper.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data; if the model cannot explain the signal it does not ship. Built solo end to end: product, agent stack, UI, and live user validation on real feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI-Native Property Experiences
projects.description: AI-native workflow for real estate teams. A vision pipeline turns inspection photos into structured, queryable records; LLM agents then compose multilingual, marketing-ready property listings end to end. One flow from photo to published experience, zero copy-paste. Designed and built solo.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: AI Native Design Engineer and Product Builder
_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Native Design Engineer and Product Builder (Basel). Adobe Experience Manager is being reinvented around AI. Agentic systems now migrate legacy sites, redesign them to brand, generate new experiences from a brief, and stand them up on modern edge delivery. Looking for someone who can build a full-stack application end to end with AI as a core tool, and who brings a designer's eye to everything they ship. Invent and prototype with taste; amplify design craft with AI; validate with real customers; share the work openly.
